feature_checks.boundary: Actual production copy/watchdog helpers, RPC policy, queue admission and payload and atomic album-failure snippets execute with native SignalKit primitives/operators. Time/Queue/Timer, peer/resource values, Postbox side effects, network RPC and UIKit are explicit adapters. Filesystem preview checks use real temporary regular files. No Telegram RPC, full native app typecheck, Apple SDK or physical-device delivery is proven.

source_gate.historical_runtime_boundary: exact published bytes after verified inverse of all registered late source stages

observed_video.definite_case: own copy of a poll with video remains pending

verified: process suspension and offline idle budget
atomic pending album failure and preserved message fields
retry uses existing IDs and random_id

physical_limits: Production bodies execute in explicit SignalKit/queue/clock/network-status/Postbox boundaries. Live Telegram RPC, iPhone decoding and actual OS suspension are not exercised; the exact device RPC error is unknown.
